name: Elon Musk
bio: Elon Musk is a visionary entrepreneur, engineer, and investor known for co-founding PayPal, SpaceX, Neuralink, and xAI, as well as leading Tesla, Inc. to become the world's most valuable electric automaker. His pioneering efforts at SpaceX made commercial reusable orbital rocketry a reality and reduced the cost of space exploration tenfold. Musk is frequently ranked as the world's wealthiest individual and an advocate of interplanetary human colonization.

famousWorks.title: Founded SpaceX with Falcon 1 & Starship rockets
Delivered Tesla Roadster & steered Tesla to mass production (Model S/3/Y)
Co-founded OpenAI as a research initiative

awards: Heinlein Prize for Advances in Space Commercialization (2011)

faq.q: What major startups did Elon Musk create or co-found?
faq.a: Musk co-founded Zip2, X.com (which merged into PayPal), SpaceX, OpenAI, Neuralink, The Boring Company, and xAI, and has led Tesla since 2004.

faq.q: What is the mission of SpaceX?
faq.a: To revolutionize space technology with reusable orbital launch vehicles and ultimately enable humans to become a multi-planetary species by colonizing Mars.

name: Sam Altman
bio: Samuel Harris Altman is an American entrepreneur, investor, and the chief executive officer of OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT and GPT-4. Prior to OpenAI, he served as the president of Y Combinator, the premier startup accelerator that nurtured Airbnb, Stripe, and Dropbox. Altman is at the epicenter of modern artificial general intelligence (AGI) research, nuclear fusion investments, and computing infrastructure.

famousWorks.title: Became CEO of OpenAI transitioning to capped-profit model
Public launch of ChatGPT sparking the global generative AI wave

awards: Time 100 Most Influential People in the World (2023)
Honorary Degree from National University of Singapore

faq.q: What role did Sam Altman play in the development of ChatGPT?
faq.a: As CEO of OpenAI, Altman spearheaded the strategic vision and funding partnerships that brought large language models like GPT-3, GPT-4, and ChatGPT to global scale.

faq.q: What was Altman's role at Y Combinator?
faq.a: He was a member of Y Combinator's inaugural 2005 batch and subsequently served as its president from 2014 to 2019.
